Thus, the mathematical definition provided in the evidence strictly confines opacity to the range $[0, 1]$, where 0 corresponds to no attenuation (transparent) and values approaching 1 correspond to high attenuation (opaque). The claim is fully supported by the mathematical definitions in the source.
